svg.title: Kernel, memory, scheduling, caching, speculation, and parallelism choices are all selected against one measured hardware bottleneck.
svg.desc: Each optimization layer targets a different constraint: kernel fusion and quantization change what the GPU computes and stores, PagedAttention and continuous batching change how memory and scheduling are managed, prefix caching and speculative decoding change how much redundant work runs, and parallelism changes how work is split across GPUs. All of them are evaluated against the same measured hardware bottleneck and the application's quality, latency, and cost targets.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Inference optimizations stack on one measured bottleneck

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Each layer is independently selectable — pick it because it addresses the constraint you actually measured.
